oakland.NamesUsed: Vladimir Gonzalez (RF), Darrin Davis (DH), Isley Kelley (SS), Vinnie Keane (DH)
oakland.Notes: A's host Twins in game 1 and 2 in Oakland and win both games behind a game 1 win by Travis Coles and game 2 win by Arturo Ramos. Enter game in 3 in Minnesota. The A's bats explode in game 3 and the A's bullpen appears as its potential achilies heal. The A's would get on the great start with a 5-2 lead through 5 innings behind 4 hrs. However 6th inning the Twins would finally get to Rivas for 3 runs and continue the inning on to get 3 more off Hitoki Ka. Through 7 innings the A's would be trailing 6-5. In the 8th the A's would hit back to back homeruns with Gonzalez and Desmond Morton. The A's would tack on 2 more homeruns in the 9th to win 9-6. Game 3 homeruns - Isley Kelley (2), Darrin Davis (2), Vladimir Gonzalez (2), Desmond Morton, Ernesto Quintero. Vinnie Keane got the start in game 3 as went 3-4, this man has no end.

oakland.NamesUsed: Pablo Almanzar (SP), Eric Taveras (2B), John Ellis (SP)
oakland.Notes: Game 4 Minnesota hosts A's trying to avoid the sweep. After an impressive season in their own right winning 103 games, the Minnesota Twins face one last challenge. John Ellis just pitched a complete game shut out to close out NY in the ALDS. However things would be a little different this time around as Ellis would struggle mightly giving up 5 ER in route to a loss. To make matters worse Twins starting pitcher was a rookie debut , with their Ace on the injured list. Setting the stage for game 5 in Oakland. Minnesota would roll out their 2nd best arm , who is more a 1-B than a 2. A's would counter Twins game 4 approach and roll out their own rookie arm in Pablo Almanzar. Almazar who debuted earlier this season with a no-hitter was up to his same tricks in game 5. Pablo Alamzar would retire every single batter and with 2 outs in the 9th, basehit to right field. The very next batter strikes out. Unbelievably Almanzar closes out the ALCS and stamp A's ticket to the World Series. Carrying the offensive load was Eric Taveras with 2 home-runs in the 4-0 victory.
oakland.StoryAngle: John Ellis struggles in a game 4 loss, while Pablo Almanzar playoff debut reads almost like his MLB debut pitching a 1 hit shutout. Game 4 As (4) Twins (9), Game 5 As (4) Twins (0).

oakland.Notes: Eric Taveras continues to be a huge signing this past offseason as he adds to impressive season winning the Postseason MVP honors leading into the World Series
oakland.StoryAngle: Eric Taveras win Post Season MVP

oakland.NamesUsed: Mike Paulson, Deacon Seymour, Arturo Ramos (SP), Danny Horn (CF)
oakland.Notes: The table is set for the World Series as The A's will play the Phillies and the A's will have home field advantage. Mike Paulson spoke on how special the season has been and chasing a 7th championship in the dynasty window. Paulson sharing that its extra special to be doing it on Vinnie Keanes farewell season. Adding that the idea of the A's without Keane and Dillon next season is a sobering thought and trying to savor it all. Paulson also gave praise to first year manager Deacon Seymour on making the World Series and joked, "you set the bar too high kid". Deacon Seymour also addressed the media and confirmed that the A's would start Arturo Ramos in game 1. Ramos who was the Ace this season and runner up in the Cy Young race to teammate Travis Coles, saw Coles starting game 1 of the previous 2 series. When Seymour was asked why on the change, Seymour stated the matchups and favor Ramos a bit more. Seymour was also asked to speak on MVP Danny Horn's struggles this season and if there were any plans to move Horn from the leadoff spot.Horn is batting just .190 with 0 homeruns. Seymour acknowledged Horn may be pressing a bit and has no doubt Horn bat will influence the next series and wouldnt think to move him from his natural leadoff spot.

oakland.NamesUsed: Wilson Shepard, Adash Stanley (PG), AJ Dybantsa (SF)
oakland.Notes: After a peak into the rookies in the rookie camp the NBA preseason officially begins this cycle. Rookie AJ Dybantsa showed true potential and 2nd year Adash Stanley continued to show his crafty scoring and hustle mentality. Now rookie Head Coach will have the oppurtunity to run them with the rest of the roster in the preseason. After losing all 4 rookie camp games Shepard shared that they team was looking to get their first taste of winning sooner than later.
oakland.StoryAngle: Coach Wilson Shepard prepares his rookies for preseaon.

oakland.Notes: In The Oaks first preseason game the story remained the same from rookie camp as the Oaks lose to the Pistons, 104-101. Not for a lack of trying but at a lack of over playing the wins signifigance. As the final moments didnt see the regulars in the game. Austin Reaves scored 22 through 3Qs, AJ Dyabansta, who played the final minutes trying to secure this win, scored 18, Adash Stanley and Dillon Brooks both struggled for the field both scoring 7, while Jerami Grant and Wendell Carter Jr. did not play in this one. The Oaks now through 4 rookie camp games and 1 preseason sit at 0-5, Much to Draymond Greens delight.
oakland.StoryAngle: The Oaks stumble in game 1 of the preseason and have yet to get a win in the era of The Oaks.
